I don't have any notes for you yet. My one attempt to load the source pages failed, and I've run out of tool calls for this turn before I could read anything from them.

I tried to load six pages at once:
- https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ezekiel-44/
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/ezekiel/44.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/ezekiel/44.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/ezekiel/44.htm
- https://www.preceptaustin.org/ezekiel-44-commentary
- https://netbible.org/bible/Ezekiel+44

The script crashed on the first page before printing any text. The result was a string where I expected a list, so it was probably an error message, but I never saw it. That means I can't tell you whether those pages are reachable.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't written notes from my own memory of Ezekiel 44. That includes the usual topics, like the shut east gate in verses 1–3, Levites and Zadokites in verses 10–16, and the priests' rules in verses 17–31.

If you ask again, I'll start with the six pages above and check each result before reading it. Then I'll search for the different traditions' views: Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan, Pentecostal and Lutheran sources, plus Catholic and Orthodox readings on newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org. The Catholic and Orthodox pages will likely focus on reading the shut gate in verse 2 as a picture of Mary. After that I'll write the verse-by-verse notes, each point with its URL.
